policy_notes: A DIM week whose own date set intersects any range below may not be used as the ratio denominator (x[8] for the current year, y[8] for a reference-year candidate).
Nothing else changes: no other Spring Festival week's actual value is edited, interpolated, shifted or reshaped, and no data-derived 'anomalous week' threshold is introduced.
This is a boundary rule that requires explicit user confirmation. Set confirmed_by_user to true only after checking the dates against the cited source.
The reference pool now spans 2023-2026, so every year in it needs an entry here; a reference year with no entry is refused rather than treated as having no holiday.
